source: Endpoint, token types, 15-minute expiry and 'consumed on use' VERBATIM from https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/tokens/create and https://api.elevenlabs.io/openapi.json (paths./v1/single-use-token/{token_type}.post, components.schemas.SingleUseTokenType), accessed 2026-10-08. Wire, parsed result and errors MEASURED with the real SDK 2.71.0 + Node 22.22.3 real fetch against a local server, fake key (logs/stage-03/survey/probe-stream.mjs, case single-use-token). SDK: api/resources/tokens/resources/singleUse/client/Client.d.ts l.26. The token value is the docs' own example.

fixture.requestParameters: NONE besides the path segment: no TTL, no model, no scope, no session config (openapi: only token_type in path and the xi-api-key header).
fixture.responseFieldDoc: token (string, required) - A time bound single use token that expires after 15 minutes. Will be consumed on use.
fixture.responseHeaders: None documented. No usage / cost header is documented for this endpoint.
fixture.hosts: Served on every host incl. https://api.us.elevenlabs.io and the residency hosts (eu/in/sg) - the server list on the token page. GUESS: a token issued on a residency host only works against that host's wss endpoint (each residency host is a separate account with its own key per stage-02 facts §2; not documented for tokens).

expect.result: What the browser needs: the token string; it must pick the model and session options itself (the token carries none). The browser connects to wss://<host>/v1/speech-to-text/realtime?model_id=scribe_v2_realtime&token=<token>.
expect.expiry: Fixed by the vendor: 15 minutes from issue, single use. coax cannot shorten or lengthen it; it can state it (e.g. an expiresAt computed at issue time - a coax computation, the API returns no timestamp).
expect.usage: The token call itself: no cost documented (GUESS: free - pricing lists audio duration only). The realtime session it opens is billed by audio duration (stage-02 facts §8: Realtime $0.39/h) but runs browser <-> vendor; coax never sees it and the realtime protocol carries no usage/duration event (realtime-scribe.messages.json).
expect.retry: A 429/5xx on token issue is retried by coax like any call (isTransient on statusCode). Issuing twice is harmless (an unused token expires).
